name: ManageBotUser
description: Admin only: open the manage-user card to change Role and/or SalesOrg for a linked SAP user. Use for 'manage user DEV-249', 'set role DEV-xxx', 'set sales org DEV-xxx'. Does not save until the Admin confirms on the card. Requires sap_user_id.

sap_user_id.description: SAP user id to manage (e.g. DEV-249).
